title: Footwear Purchase History and Made-to-Order Deposit Percentages: A Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Casebook
content:
**Governing rule.** On a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation, footwear lines booked on the customer's orders in the last 24 months take percentage points off the made-to-order deposit percentage, before it is applied to the price:

- 8 lines or more: 5 points off;
- 4 up to 7 lines (4 or more, fewer than 8): 2 points off;
- fewer than 4 lines: 0 points off.

The lines counted are order lines of the footwear product class on the customer's Online Orders. Each is counted by its booking date, and only those booked within the last 24 months are counted.

**Cases (hypothetical)**

| Case | Footwear lines booked in the last 24 months | Points off |
|---|---|---|
| A | 3 | 0 |
| B | 4 | 2 |
| C | 7 (plus 3 more booked 30 months ago) | 2 |
| D | 8 | 5 |

**Reading the cases.** In case C the three older lines fall outside the 24 months and are not counted. Case D sits exactly on 8 lines, which counts as "8 lines or more".
